_comment: STILL image generation (profile avatar, chat header, session bubble).
GENERATE THIS FIRST: the chosen render is the reference image that
video.json requires, and the source tutor_images.py crops from.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
assistant's display name, because names are placeholders that can be
replaced. When renaming, pick a name that fits THIS file, not the reverse.
role: session assistant - welcomes the class, runs timekeeping, hosts the break Q&A and answers in private chat. Deliberately NOT styled as a teacher: no board, no chalk, no formal wear.

identity._heritage_note: a deliberate casting choice so the three hosts are visibly different people; not inferred from any name
identity.build: average height, calm and still in the way she holds herself

face: oval face with soft features, large dark brown eyes with long lashes, straight nose, full lips, warm light-brown skin with a golden undertone, a small beauty spot at the right jawline
hair: long straight dark brown hair, usually loose with one side tucked behind the ear, sometimes a low ponytail; no fringe

wardrobe.default: simple long-sleeve top in dusty pink, teal or charcoal, sleeves pushed up; sometimes a light open overshirt; nothing corporate, nothing branded

presence.pose: sits or stands relaxed, leaning very slightly forward as if paying close attention; hands often resting one over the other, gesturing small when she speaks
presence.default_expression: calm and encouraging, a small closed-mouth smile - the face of someone who is not going to rush you
presence.energy: steady and reassuring; the host who makes a nervous student feel it is fine to ask
presence.spoken_register: clear, unhurried South African English, gently warm; never bubbly, never formal

continuity_anchors: long straight dark hair tucked behind one ear
beauty spot at the right jawline
_continuity_note: the features that MUST survive every regeneration - if these read the same, the audience accepts it as the same person

prompts.headshot: Editorial headshot of a 23-28 year old Indian South African woman, a friendly session host (not a teacher). oval face with soft features, large dark brown eyes with long lashes, straight nose, full lips, warm light-brown skin with a golden undertone, a small beauty spot at the right jawline. Hair: long straight dark brown hair, usually loose with one side tucked behind the ear, sometimes a low ponytail; no fringe. Wearing simple long-sleeve top in dusty pink, teal or charcoal, sleeves pushed up; sometimes a light open overshirt; nothing corporate, nothing branded. small gold nose stud. Expression: calm and encouraging, a small closed-mouth smile - the face of someone who is not going to rush you. Chest-up, slight three-quarter turn, eyes to camera. large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred warm interior background. full-frame mirrorless, 85mm f/1.8. photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, corporate stock-photo headset, call-centre imagery, generic stock-photo smile
_negative_note: the stock-photo and call-centre terms are deliberate: prompts for a 'host' drift toward headset-wearing support-agent imagery, which is the wrong register

headshot.lighting: large softbox key at 45 degrees, subtle hair light, grey seamless or softly blurred warm interior background
headshot.framing: chest-up, eyes on the upper third, slight three-quarter turn
